objective: Determine evidence-linked identity and potency framework required before comparing SGL-001 lots or advancing intranasal formulation into cross-species PK/PD.
proposed_next_action: Assemble and submit Stage-1 CMC/analytics package per program plan: 1) MCB/WCB characterization and qualification records; 2) orthogonal QC panel definition and fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision); 3) stability-indicating potency assay development with correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint; 4) three GMP-like production run reports showing reproducible release/stability/potency; 5) ex vivo and in vivo formulation/device compatibility demonstrating intact-EV recovery with appropriate controls. Then request regulator briefing/pre-IND advice. Bounded timeline: 3 months to assemble initial dossier & plan for GLP large-animal biodistribution/tox studies; escalate resources if assay development slips.

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: Supported: The supplied MISEV2023 consensus guidance explicitly recommends transparent, orthogonal characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, and appropriate experimental controls. These high-level recommendations map directly to the need for an orthogonal QC panel, defined/validated intact-EV assays, and stability-indicating potency assays as preconditions for attributing in vivo effects to intact EV preparations and for progressing formulations. Evidence IDs: ev-misev2023-quality-framework. Limitations: MISEV is a consensus guideline and does not provide program-specific numerical thresholds (e.g., LLOQ, stability windows) or demonstrate that SGL-001 meets these expectations. Evidence gap: program-specific validated assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision), MCB/WCB generation records, and GMP-like batch comparability data are not present in the supplied evidence. Search needed: true. Requested evidence: ["MCB/WCB characterization reports", "fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision)", "stability-indicating potency assay development and correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint", "comparability data across 3 GMP-like batches"].
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: No program-specific validated assays, MCB/WCB, batch reproducibility or stability/potency correlation data are available in the provided evidence.
limitations: Guidance does not define numerical acceptance criteria for assays or stability specific to SGL-001.
No program-specific CMC data supplied in the allowed evidence to demonstrate execution of MISEV recommendations.
requested_evidence: fit-for-purpose validation reports for intact-EV assays (LLOQ, specificity, precision)
stability-indicating potency assay development and correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint

strongest_support_summary: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) provides a consensus quality framework that directly supports requiring orthogonal EV characterization, separation from non-vesicular particles, transparent reporting, and appropriate controls prior to attributing in vivo effects to intact EVs or advancing formulations.
